search.heading: How Do Patients in Delhi Search and Choose a Clinic or a Hospital?
search.body: Delhi patients rarely search one neighbourhood. They compare clinics across Delhi, Gurgaon and Noida, check reviews and ask about cost before they call.

points.title: Cross-Border Searches
points.body: A patient in Vasant Kunj may compare a Saket clinic with one on Gurgaon’s Golf Course Road.

points.title: Metro-Led Locality Searches
points.body: Patients search “dentist near Saket metro” or “IVF centre in Vasant Kunj,” not just “Delhi.”

faqs.q: Which Is the Best Healthcare Digital Marketing Agency in Delhi?
faqs.a: Look for healthcare-only experience, local proof and tracking beyond leads. Reinvent Digital works only with hospitals and clinics, and measures Delhi campaigns by bookings and walk-ins, not clicks.

faqs.q: How Much Does Healthcare Digital Marketing Cost in Delhi?
faqs.a: It depends on your specialities, number of centres and competition in your localities. After a short call and audit, we share a scoped plan with costs before anything starts.
